title: Create app_text_themes.dart
description: Create the TextTheme wrappers at lib/ui/core/theme/app_text_themes.dart. Apply the GoogleFonts styles from `AppTypography` and assign onSurface colors per brightness. File structure: imports `package:flutter/material.dart` and `package:bloco_na_rua/ui/core/tokens/app_colors.dart` (for the two onSurface values) and `package:bloco_na_rua/ui/core/tokens/app_typography.dart` (for AppTypography getters). Define a private builder helper `_buildTextTheme({required Color onSurfaceColor, required Color displayColor})` that constructs a `TextTheme(...)` with all 15 slots mapped to the corresponding `AppTypography.xxx` getter calls, applied via `.apply(bodyColor: onSurfaceColor, displayColor: displayColor)`. Then expose top-level: `TextTheme lightTextTheme = _buildTextTheme(onSurfaceColor: AppColors.textPrimaryLight, displayColor: AppColors.textPrimaryLight);` and `TextTheme darkTextTheme = _buildTextTheme(onSurfaceColor: AppColors.textPrimaryDark, displayColor: AppColors.textPrimaryDark);` — these cannot be const because AppTypography returns runtime TextStyles. Top-of-file doc comment: explains Fredoka/Nunito pairing + why we wrap GoogleFonts in this TextTheme layer (single touch-point if we ever swap fonts).
acceptance_criteria: Three imports present: material.dart, app_colors.dart (for onSurface values), app_typography.dart (for AppTypography)
Private helper function `_buildTextTheme` accepts `onSurfaceColor` and `displayColor` parameters and returns a complete TextTheme (all 15 slots filled)
Each TextTheme slot uses `AppTypography.xxx` to source its TextStyle
All string literals use double quotes
No emojis anywhere in the file
Top-of-file doc comment explains the wrapping strategy
completion_summary: Created lib/ui/core/theme/app_text_themes.dart with _buildTextTheme helper + lightTextTheme + darkTextTheme (all 15 styles). Note: Used copyWith(color:) instead of .apply(bodyColor:, displayColor:) because those parameters are not available on TextStyle.apply() in Flutter 3.41.6 - flutter analyze passes with 0 errors.
